title: Nagata map
description: The Nagata automorphism of affine 3-space: a polynomial automorphism with Jacobian determinant identically 1 that is wild (not tame). Often cited alongside the Jacobian conjecture; as an automorphism it is bijective, not a non-injective fiber counterexample. FactoryWager uses the name for related audit-graph edges (sample finding ↔ concepts).
references: Masayoshi Nagata — wild (non-tame) polynomial automorphism of A^3 with Jac ≡ 1
Jacobian conjecture (Keller) — open for dim ≥ 2; Nagata automorphism illustrates tameness vs Jacobian-determinant questions
